prompts.damps: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG sprite atlas for a 2D arcade beat-em-up mini boss. Primary request: create Damps, a tall very skinny adult French village guy who constantly smokes a cigarette, in consistent pixel art. Composition: precise 4 by 4 grid, 16 isolated full-body sprites, side three-quarter view facing right, each pose centered in its own equal cell with generous transparent gutters. Row 1 idle smoking, walk stride one, walk stride two, light cigarette flick projectile. Row 2 deeply bent coughing a broad smoke cloud forward, long exhale creating a dense purple-gray smoke plume, throwing cigarette butt low forward, recoiling/hurt. Row 3 Damps winding up a cigarette-butt shot, exhaling a long plume, crouching into cough cone attack, idle smoking alternate pose. Row 4 elite-stage Damps with longer black coat and red scarf, idle, run, coughing cloud, throwing a lit cigarette. Keep the cigarette visibly in his mouth in idle poses. Dark outline, crisp detailed 16-bit pixel art, consistent identity, genuine transparent background, no labels, no text, no grid lines, no environment, no ground shadows. Each sprite fits inside middle 65% of cell.
